description: This file contains utility functions and classes for dumpstate operations in Android, including process management, command execution with options, and property checks.
external_files: <system headers: dirent.h, fcntl.h, sys/prctl.h, sys/wait.h, unistd.h>
<android-base headers: file.h, properties.h, stringprintf.h, strings.h, unique_fd.h>

classes.name: CommandOptions
classes.description: Class representing command execution options such as timeout, privilege mode, output redirection, and logging.

classes.name: CommandOptions::CommandOptionsBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing CommandOptions with various settings.

classes.name: CommandOptions::CommandOptionsValues
classes.description: Internal storage for command options parameters.

methods.name: waitpid_with_timeout
methods.description: Waits for a process to change state with a timeout, handling signals appropriately.

methods.name: CommandOptions::WithTimeout
methods.description: Creates a CommandOptionsBuilder with specified timeout in seconds.

methods.name: CommandOptions::WithTimeoutInMs
methods.description: Creates a CommandOptionsBuilder with specified timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: PropertiesHelper::IsUserBuild
methods.description: Checks if the build type is 'user'.

methods.name: PropertiesHelper::IsDryRun
methods.description: Checks if the system is in dry run mode.

methods.name: PropertiesHelper::IsUnroot
methods.description: Checks if unroot property is enabled.

methods.name: PropertiesHelper::IsParallelRun
methods.description: Checks if parallel run property is enabled.

methods.name: DumpFileToFd
methods.description: Dumps the contents of a file to a file descriptor, with error handling.

methods.name: RunCommandToFd
methods.description: Runs a command with specified options, redirects output, handles timeouts, and logs execution.
